verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows Tilled's PayFac/ISV model — merchant onboarding, pricing templates for ISV fee percentages, payouts, disputes, webhooks — but nowhere describes a multi-party split-payment object that routes one charge across several sellers with adjustable/reversible splits. Tilled's fee model is ISV-vs-merchant (one merchant per charge), not marketplace-style fan-out to multiple sellers.
